reviews.x: Love it! I have posted a picture of my first day (image with more of mouth showing) and a picture after one week using 2 timds daily. No to little taste. Comes as a powder. Wet brush and dip in powder (doesnot cause powder clumping). The results are gradual but noticeable to me, idk how well the images do at showing it but it IS WORKING. My teeth feel SO clean!! I usually rinse with mouthwash after to get leftover powder from mouth. Not foamy, just sort of turns to a liquid.Update -added btetter

reviews.t: OMG this stuff is amazing, I have been mixing it with baking soda ...
reviews.x: OMG this stuff is amazing, I have been mixing it with baking soda and a couple drops of water and putting it in my rubber teeth whitining trays for 30 to 45 minutes. After removing the trays I brush my teeth with what's remaining in my mouth for one to two minutes. I've charted my progress on a white scale. My teeth were a 9 on top and 13 on bottom on a color scale chart. All my teeth are now at a 4 and I have only used this method 4 times. For the first time in my life perfectly white teeth are

reviews.t: I do like how clean my teeth feel
reviews.x: Still waiting to see the effects. Maybe a little whiter or is it greyish instead of yellow?  I do like how clean my teeth feel.  Don't like the black all over the sink that requires a full wipe down after each brushing. I also need to make sure my face and mouth are fully clean before leaving the bathroom because of the black that is left around the mouth and between the teeth. A good rinse and face wash after use is recommended, then take that towel and wipe down the sink! Gums were a little so

reviews.t: The cons outweigh the pros- update on the bottom
reviews.x: So far, so good. Ive only used it for about 4 days, and you need to use it 2x a day, for about 2 weeks in order to see true effects. (According to the package) However! I can already tell that the coffee and tea stains are starting to fade. I'm really looking forward to the two week mark! Added bonus: you have a BLACK MOUTH while brushing... awesome for playing tricks on your children, and will be an amazing Halloween prank to play on my husband... can you tell I like the tricks more than the tr

Seems to be working...my teeth and gums both look and feel better after 2 weeks of using this 1-2 times a day. Doesn't taste like anything, but will make your toothbrush black so I just use a spare one I have when I use it. Top picture is before, bottom picture is 2 weeks after using it 1-2 times every day.
I've only used it once to brush my teeth so far. There isn't really any noticeable taste. I can notice a slight change in color with just one use

reviews.t: Teeth are looking better. so yeah
reviews.x: wouldn't have believed it if it weren't for the results.  Teeth are looking better. so yeah, if you're a tea drinker or smoker, give it a try!

reviews.t: Just got it today. Tried it for the first ...
reviews.x: Just got it today. Tried it for the first time and noticed a difference! Now, it should be said that I chew tobacco, so I would assume I would see obvious results sooner than someone whose teeth may already be "white". Since I've only used it once I can't give it 5 stars, but in a month, with continued results.... I will definitely be giving it 5 stars!!!

I would def recommend the actual charcoal paste instead of the powder. It actually works, but the only downfall of the powder is that the little charcoal fibers, which are coconut derived, stick in between your teeth and in your gums. You literally have to floss each area every time you use it. Other than that, I love the product!

This is the very first time I try these kinda teeth solutions. One word: magic! Not sure why it works that fast but I've noticed clear difference within 2 days in terms of whitening AND cavity cleaning (the wellewish thingy). Happy with my purchase

reviews.t: Removing stains after only a few days
reviews.x: I have been using this for a few days now and it works.  I smoke and drink coffee and this is removing stains after just a few weeks.  I bought this because of so many positive reviews.
I really enjoy this product.  I have used it for over 30 days and I get lots of compliments on my smile and the whiteness of my teeth. I will buy this product again.
This stuff really works! After 5 uses I see and feel a difference, wasnt expecting it to clean so well on top of whiten!. No bad taste

reviews.t: Great Stuff I can see a difference in 2 days
reviews.x: Great Stuff I can see a difference in 2 days. I had a small tobacco stain from a cigar here and there and it is now gone.
We've seen a visible difference after using this after a few days! Definitely recommend.

reviews.t: seen change in the first time great product highly recommend it to anyone
reviews.x: seen change in the first time  great product  highly recommend it to anyone

So, I’ve only been using this for a couple of days but I am loving it!!! It is great for sensitive teeth and doesn’t feel super weird in your mouth! My teeth are already a couple shades whiter, removing stains I forgot I had! The container is also a lot bigger than I expected so I’m excited to get my 3 to 6 month use out of it! Thank you and I will definitely be buying more!

reviews.t: it's fun to see your mouth full of black foam -- ...
reviews.x: I don't see much if any change, certainly no startling results. I even wonder if it just grays the enamel a bit, toning down the original yellowish cast. I'm going to keep using it until the jar is empty; will update if anything changes. (On the upside, it's fun to see your mouth full of black foam -- and to smile broadly at your husband with horror-movie mouth.)

If you think this equals to a laser whitening you will be disappointed 😞. I have been using it for about a month and i haven't seen a difference. I'm a coffee drinker and have never had a professional whitening, so i was hoping this natural way would do the job but it didn't. Maybe works as a "maintenance" after a professional whitening. Bummed!

I brushed my teeth 2x today both times with dental aid WOW my teeth already look brighter - My husband and i are sitting at the computer paying the house bills and my husband states "Hey your teeth Look really white" Yep this works. It is a bit off putting to have all this blackness in your mouth but rinse and poof ~ white and slick teeth!

Product arrived in a very timely manner.  Within a few days of use I could tell a big difference in the whiteness of my teeth.  I have used the bleach products in the past and think I prefer this to the bleach.  Leaving the bleach products on for any amount of time would irritate my gums but this product doesn't do that.  Glad I found it.

I've started using this in addition to my toothpaste. At first, it's a little disorienting seeing black foam all over your teeth and mouth. Just be sure to rinse it all out.  But I can definitely say I've seen some good results. My teeth have whitened a few shades already. I look forward to seeing what continued use produces.

Pretty good product.  I can't say my teeth are too much whiter, but better.  I've been using the powder with toothpaste because the powder alone is not enough to make my mouth feel fresh.  It could just be drainage from allergies that makes it so the powder is not enough to freshen up my breath.

Although I just started using this product, I must say that I notice a little difference. I was surprised when I first used it b/c I was not aware that the powder was black. However, there is no taste to it so that is good. I look forward to the results in the weeks coming!

I have just used this three times, but I can already see subtle results and my teeth feel super clean. My gums feel no irritation at all, which was a concern. I love that it is all natural and I am going to use it everyday and hope to see better and better results...

claims.text: Many reviewers report visible whitening or stain removal within days to a few weeks of use.
Reviewers frequently note that the product has little to no taste.
Several reviewers mention the messy black powder residue on the sink, toothbrush, or between teeth.
Some reviewers say results are gradual or that they are still waiting to see effects.
A few reviewers highlight that teeth and gums feel cleaner or better after use.
